```{r load-survey-stats}
#| cache: false

survey_stats <- targets::tar_read(
  survey_stats,
  store = store_in_pipeline()
)

survey_stats$table %>% 
  readr::write_csv(file = here::here("manuscript/resources/survey_stats.csv"))

summaries <- survey_stats$table %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(
    step_short = rep(1:6, each = 3)
  )

missing_hii <- survey_stats$table %>% 
  compare_two_data_subsets("ncom", c("Convergent local trends", "Correct pressure data"))

non_convergent <- survey_stats$table %>% 
  compare_two_data_subsets("nseries", c("Abundant enough species", "Convergent local trends"))

r_version_clean <- R.version$version.string %>% str_replace(" \\(.+", "")
```
